name: YepWatch

apple.subtitle: Pick movies & shows together
apple.promotionalText: Turn “what should we watch?” into “press play.” Share a room, swipe Yep or Nope, and find a movie or show everyone wants to watch.

google.shortDescription: Swipe Yep or Nope. Find a movie or show you all want to watch.

description:
What should we watch? Settle it with a Yep.

YepWatch makes choosing a movie or TV show part of the fun. Create a room, invite your people, and swipe from your own phones. Big Yep. Big Nope. A shared pick you actually agree on.

SWIPE WITH FEELING
Say Yep to something you would watch, or Nope to something you wouldn’t. Expressive reactions bring every choice to life. Your individual votes stay private while shared matches appear as you go.

BRING YOUR IDEAS
A feel-good comedy? Something tense? A particular genre or a whole different mood? Add ideas to the room and explore movies and shows together.

MAKE THE FINAL PICK TOGETHER
Open your matches, propose a title, and agree on it as a group. Once everyone agrees, YepWatch checks streaming availability again before confirming your choice.

YOUR PEOPLE, YOUR PHONES
Choose on your own, plan a date night, or get the whole group involved. Share an invitation link so friends can join from their phones or in a browser.

FIND WHERE TO WATCH
Choose your country and bring your streaming services. See which services offer a title and follow a link when you are ready to watch.

COME BACK FOR ANOTHER NIGHT
Start as a guest, return to your rooms, and revisit past decisions. Optional GoodWatch sign-in brings your saved services and keeps your rooms and decision history available across devices.

YepWatch helps you choose what to watch. Movies and shows play on the streaming provider’s service, which may require its own subscription. Availability varies by country and can change.
